title: RBI Fixes ₹1 Lakh Crore Asset Threshold for NBFC Upper Layer Classification
summary: Classifies NBFCs with ≥ ₹1 lakh crore assets into Upper Layer (UL) subjecting them to mandatory listing.

blocks.content: Classifies NBFCs with ≥ ₹1 lakh crore assets into Upper Layer (UL) subjecting them to mandatory listing.

items: Asset Size Benchmark: NBFCs with asset size ₹1 lakh crore and above classified into NBFC-UL.
State Risk Weight: 20% risk weight applies to offset exposures backed by State Government guarantees.
Tata Sons Impact: Tata Sons (standalone asset size ~₹1.75 lakh crore) covered under mandatory listing requirement.
